name: InventaFood - Lista de compras por proveedor

parameters.query:
WITH ultimo AS (
  SELECT dc.id_item_inventario,
         c.id_proveedor,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY dc.id_item_inventario ORDER BY c.fecha_hora DESC, c.id_compra DESC) AS rn
  FROM Detalle_Compra dc
  JOIN Compra c ON c.id_compra = dc.id_compra
)
SELECT COALESCE(pr.nombre, 'Sin proveedor asignado') AS proveedor,
       COALESCE(i.nombre, p.nombre) AS articulo,
       COALESCE(i.unidad_base, 'unidad') AS unidad,
       ii.stock_actual,
       ii.stock_minimo,
       GREATEST(ii.stock_minimo * 2 - ii.stock_actual, 0) AS cantidad_sugerida
FROM Item_Inventario ii
LEFT JOIN Ingrediente i ON i.id_ingrediente = ii.id_ingrediente
LEFT JOIN Producto p ON p.id_producto = ii.id_producto
LEFT JOIN ultimo u ON u.id_item_inventario = ii.id_item_inventario AND u.rn = 1
LEFT JOIN Proveedor pr ON pr.id_proveedor = u.id_proveedor
WHERE ii.stock_actual <= ii.stock_minimo
ORDER BY proveedor, articulo;
